trails.why: Brebeneskul is a peak in the Chornohora region of Ukraine, with height of 2,035 meters above sea level.

trails.name: Hutyn Tomnatyk summit
trails.why: Hutyn Tomnatyk is a peak in the Chornohora region of Ukraine, with height of 2,016 meters above sea level.

trails.name: Menchul summit near Yasinya
trails.why: Menchul, also Manchul, is a peak in the Chornohora region of Ukraine, with height of 1,998 meters above sea level.

trails.name: Smotrych summit
trails.why: Smotrich is one of the peaks of Montenegro's mountain range. It is located in the Verkhov district of the Ivano-Frankivsk region, within the Carpathian National Natural Park.

trails.name: Dzembronia summit
trails.why: Dzembronia is a peak located in the Chornohora mountain range of Carpathian Mountains in western Ukraine.

trails.name: Syvulia Velyka summit
trails.why: The Great Sivulia is a mountain in the Ukrainian Carpathians. It is one of the peaks of the Sivulia mountain range, the highest mountain in the Gorgan Massif. It is located in the Ivano-Frankivsk region on the upper reaches of the Limnica and Bistrika rivers of Solotvinska.

trails.name: Ihrovets summit
trails.why: It is the third highest peak in the Gorgon Mountains. The most interesting thing about this mountain is that its summit, unlike the other Gorgon Mountains, is almost flat.

trails.name: Vysoka summit
trails.why: Wysoka, a town in Greater Poland Voivodeship

trails.name: Bratkivska Velyka summit
trails.why: Bratkov mountain in the Ukrainian Carpathians, in the Gorgani massif.

trails.name: Homul summit
trails.why: Gomul is a mountain in the Ukrainian Carpathians, in the Montenegrin mountain range. It is located in the Overvyrnyansk region of the Ivano-Frankivsk region, within the Carpathian National Natural Park and is the northern tip of Spiti Mountain.

trails.name: Parenky summit
trails.why: Parenka is a mountain peak in the Ukrainian Carpathians, on the mountain ridge Parenka in the Gorgani Massif. It is located in the southern part of the Kaluski district of the Ivano-Frankivsk region, on the eponymous Parenka ridge.

trails.name: Nehrovets summit
trails.why: Negrowetz is a mountain in the Ukrainian Carpathians, in the Inner Gorgans Massif. It is located within the Mid-Mountain District of the Transcarpathian region, northeast of Negrowetz and east of Sinevir.

trails.name: Petros Gorganskyi summit
trails.why: Petros is a mountain in the central part of the Gorgani Massif. It is located on the territory of the Rodznatovsky district of Ivano-Frankivsk region, between the rivers Petros, Daryjevka and Limnica.

trails.name: Serednia summit near Perehinske
trails.why: It is located on the border of the Ivano-Frankivsky and Kalusky districts of the Ivano-Frankivsky region, to the south-east of the village of Osmoly and to the west of the village of Stara Guta.

trails.name: Ruska summit
trails.why: Ruska is a mountain in the Ukrainian Carpathians, in the Gorgani massif. It is located on the border of the Overvirnyan region of Ivano-Frankivsk region and the Ravich region of the Transcarpathian region.

trails.name: Perednia summit
trails.why: The mountain in the Ukrainian Carpathians is the highest peak of the mountain range in the Gorgani mountain range. It is located on the border of the Mizhgorsky and Tichevsky districts of the Transcarpathian region, between the Mochranka and the Terebla strait.

trails.name: Horhan-Ilemskyi summit
trails.why: Gorgan-Ilemsky is a mountain peak in the Ukrainian Carpathians, in the Gorgani Massif, on the Architsk ridge.

trails.name: Zadnia summit
trails.why: It follows the summit in the southwestern part of the Gorgan, which are part of the Eastern Beskids.

trails.name: Prybui summit
trails.why: Pribuya is a summit in the southwest of Gorgan, part of the Eastern Beskids. It is located in the Bustul group, located south of the pass called the German Pass.

trails.name: Steniak summit
trails.why: Steniak is a summit in the southwestern part of the Gorgan, which is part of the Eastern Beskids.

trails.name: Darvaika summit
trails.why: Darwayka is a mountain in the Ukrainian Carpathians, in the Inner Gorgans massif. It is located in the south-eastern part of the Pishkony ridge, within the Midgill region of the Transcarpathian region, to the north-east of the village of Kolochava.

trails.name: Menchul summit near Mizhhirya
trails.why: The summit is located in the most northwestern stretch of the Gorgan, which is part of the Eastern Beskids.

trails.name: Horhulat summit
trails.why: The Great Gurgulat is the summit in the most northwestern stretch of the Gorgan, which are part of the Eastern Beskids.

trails.name: Pustoshak Velykyi summit
trails.why: The Desert is a peak in the Arszyca range, in the northern part of the Gorgan, which are part of the Eastern Beskids.

trails.name: Lysa summit
trails.why: Liza is a mountain in the Kalusky district of the Ivano-Frankivsk region.

trails.name: Staiky summit
trails.why: Steiki is a mountain in the Montenegrin massif. It is located in the southwestern part of the Verkhov district of the Ivano-Frankivsk region, south of the village of Dembroni and west of the village of Zelena.
